svg.aria-label: The five debugging questions in order: where it first went wrong, plan action or observation at fault, did the agent notice, did it recover, what would a human have done
svg.text: Open one failed trajectory: five questions, in order
Start from the one-line-per-step outline, not the full log.
1. Where did it first go wrong?
Not where it failed. Where it stopped being recoverable.
2. Plan, action, or observation at fault?
Each points at a different chapter for the fix.
An ignored error is an error-message design failure.
Good recoveries feed retry policy. Looping ones are stuck signatures.
5. What would a human have done?
At the first-wrong step. That is usually the fix.
Cluster by structural signature (failing tool + error class). Fix causes, not incidents. Verify the cluster shrinks on the eval set.
